title: Position plus orientation

steps: Pass [q.x, q.y, q.z, q.w]; the third returned value is yaw in radians.
Report x, y and yaw with report_pose and compare with the world display. Try angular-only Twist from the terminal.

A positive yaw turns counterclockwise in this world.
